answer: Resist sybils with prediction-calibration reputation: an identity earns weight by staking forecasts on future events, scored on calibration. Each forecast is a beacon of knowledge, committed before the outcome and graded after; a strong record is an inlet letting influence flow in, while wrong predictions drain stake. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes faces ten thousand forecasting histories: identical bets create a ripple of correlation that graders discount as one voice. Forging influence becomes linear forecasting labor, while an honest agent earns standing by being right, once.
